description: Nuxt module for small opt-in browser behaviors on server-rendered routes via the defineDrop macro, without hydrating the page with Vue.
rules: defineDrop is a compile-time macro; use exactly one top-level call per component with a single native HTML root element.
Pass server values through options.state (JSON-serializable only); the callback must not capture imports, props or script declarations.
Inside the callback use ctx.signal, ctx.computed and ctx.effect, not Vue APIs; register cleanup with ctx.onCleanup.
